// Arcade versus map CITY — generated by tools/mapgen/gencity.py, do not hand-edit.
//
// A T-shaped quarter of a town: asphalt streets (street) with sidewalks, the park and a courtyard (grass), houses
// under roofs (floor inside walls), the rest of the town round it (outside). Not mirrored: every point is about as
// far from either start. Nothing here is for sale.
//
// Tiles    #  house wall   .  house floor   _  asphalt   ;  sidewalk (walkable)
//          ,  the rest of the town (nobody walks there)   T  street tree and  x  car or bin (block walking
//          and bullets)
// Objects  1 and 2 are where the two teams start; A, B and C are the capture points;
//          b  hedge or flowerbed (walkable, hides you from enemies more than 2 tiles away)
//          t s d o r c  furniture in the houses: table, shelf, bed (two cells), stove, barrel, chest —
//                       each blocks walking and bullets like a crate
